chunks: She told his sister: 'Follow him.' So she kept an eye on him from a distance, while they were unaware.

key_terms.قُصِّيهِ: Follow him / Keep an eye on him
key_terms.لَا يَشْعُرُونَ: They were unaware / Did not notice

ai.seo_question: How did Moses' sister ensure he was watched safely when placed in the Nile?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the strategic wisdom (hikmah) of the divine plan, where the mother’s command to 'follow him' (qussihi) implies a gentle tracking rather than immediate retrieval, ensuring Moses remained within the royal gaze yet unnoticed by the guards. This moment of concealed providence illustrates how divine protection often operates through subtle, human agency, reinforcing the theme of God’s unseen orchestration in the narrative of the Prophets.
